High-level Nim wrapper for Pebble Accelerometer Service API.

Provides access to accelerometer data, tap events, and shake detection.

../../ffi

proc peek(data: ptr AccelData): cint {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Get the current accelerometer data without subscribing. Equivalent to C function accel_service_peek(data). Returns 0 on success, negative on error.

Set the number of samples per update. Equivalent to C function accel_service_set_samples_per_update(num_samples). Returns 0 on success, negative on error.
